name: MIG/MMA-630B Production MIG Welder 500A @ 100% Duty

images.alt: GOWELLDE MIG/MMA-630B production MIG welding machine

specs.accessories: 4m 45mm² cable, dual-drive wire feeder, 1.5m 45mm² negative cable, 500A ground clamp, 3m 36KD torch, 220V CO2 heated flowmeter regulator

summary: 500A at 100% duty with 1.6mm wire — built for non-stop production lines.
description: The MIG/MMA-630B pairs a 100% duty cycle with 0.8–1.6 mm wire capability in the full-size 655mm chassis. With 45mm² cables and the T120 transformer, it keeps feeding thick wire through the longest shifts — the flagship of the MIG line.
